patterns: APPSC asks direct data points: AP IMR as per NFHS-4 (35), life expectancy at Independence (~32), lowest-IMR state (Kerala).
Deficiency-disease one-liners (iodine-goitre, iron-anaemia) dominate the other-PSC PYQs.
NFHS coverage traps ('which is NOT included') and round-year matching recur.
App MCQs add many multi-statement items on NFHS-6/SOFI 2025 percentages that are more detailed than APPSC asks.
